title: Mexican Ground Beef Tacos
description: A classic Mexican dish made with ground beef, perfect for tacos, burritos, or other Mexican-inspired meals.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the sugar, salt, and pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Warm tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the beef mixture onto a tortilla and topping with desired toppings.
Serve with aerated bake on the side.
Optional: add diced onions, bell peppers, or other toppings to the tacos.
